backend.name: apple-vision
notes: segmentation output is model-sized (512x384 / 384x512), resampled to the frame grid
nose is Vision head_joint (the 19-joint model has no nose)
hand side is inferred from the nearest pose wrist when chirality is unknown

provenance.command: semotion.perception video=zhengqinwen_25s.mp4 fps=5.0 det=1280x614 mask_scale=4 seg=balanced

shot_detection.metric: v1 rule: rgb mean abs diff + HSV Bhattacharyya (vision._is_cut)
